PREMISES #.extraction_tip: Premises number for the additional premises/building shown on this page (page 2)

STREET ADDRESS.extraction_tip: Street address for this additional premises/building

BUILDING #.extraction_tip: Building number for this premises entry as printed on the form

BLDG DESCRIPTION.extraction_tip: Description of this building (e.g., 'Storage Garage', 'Building 2 of 4')

CONSTRUCTION TYPE.extraction_tip: Construction type for this building (e.g., Frame, Joisted Masonry)

FIRE DISTRICT.extraction_tip: Fire district name or code, if shown

CODE NUMBER.extraction_tip: Fire district code number, if shown

DISTANCE TO FIRE STATION.extraction_tip: Distance to fire station (mi or ft) for this premises

DISTANCE TO HYDRANT.extraction_tip: Distance to nearest hydrant for this premises

PROT CLASS.extraction_tip: Protection class rating for this premises/building

NUMBER OF STORIES.extraction_tip: Number of stories for this building

NUMBER OF BASEMENTS.extraction_tip: Number of basement levels for this building, if shown

TOTAL AREA (SQ FT).extraction_tip: Total square footage for this building

ui_tips: Display this as a detailed coverage table matching the page 1 COVERAGE INFORMATION format, but clearly labeled as applying to the additional premises shown on this page.

SUBJECT OF INSURANCE.extraction_tip: Subject description for coverage at this additional premises (for example, Building, Business Personal Property, or similar text in the SUBJECT OF INSURANCE column).

AMOUNT.extraction_tip: Limit for this subject; capture the full amount as printed. When normalizing, remove currency symbols and commas.

COINS %.extraction_tip: Numeric coinsurance percentage only (e.g., '80', '90', '100'). Do not include the % sign.

VALUATION.extraction_tip: Valuation code (e.g., RC, ACV, or other codes printed on this 2005 form).

CAUSES OF LOSS.extraction_tip: Full causes-of-loss text exactly as shown for this coverage line (e.g., Special, Broad, Basic).

INFLATION GUARD %.extraction_tip: Inflation guard percentage when printed; leave null if blank.

DED.extraction_tip: Deductible amount for this coverage; copy text exactly as shown, including any units or qualifiers.

DED TYPE.extraction_tip: Deductible type (Per, Dollars, Hours, etc.) when indicated in the table.

BLKT #.extraction_tip: Blanket number reference if this line is included in a blanket; null if not used.

FORMS & CONDITIONS TO APPLY.extraction_tip: Any form numbers, endorsements, or condition codes that apply to this coverage line.
